== Summary ==
Spectators crowd around the streaming table on Sunday morning. At right, eating, is [[Hayes Hunter]].

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-10-16
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-10-16 08:22 (time of the post)
* '''Identification:''' [[Hayes Hunter]] (right, eating): face match with the [[:File:2022 World Championship Top 8.jpg|Top 8 photo]], and the channel's chat at that time is about Hayes eating breakfast.
